description: Exact elapsed time between two ISO-8601 timestamps, broken into days/hours/minutes/seconds plus a human-readable summary. All components share one sign, so they sum correctly; `direction` is 'past', 'future', or 'same'.

from.description: Start of the interval, as an ISO-8601 timestamp.

timezone.description: IANA timezone used to interpret timestamps that carry no 'Z' or offset. Defaults to UTC.

to.description: End of the interval, as an ISO-8601 timestamp.

name: time_between
